summary: Iteration 3: Staff performance + document expiry reminders/pausing. Backend: 16/16 new tests passed (after 1 fix in licence.py) plus 55/55 regression tests from iterations 1-2. CRITICAL bug found and FIXED: doc_check() Mongo query 'documents.expiry': {'$nin': [None, '']} skips any driver who has at least one document without an expiry (array $nin semantics). Ravi has identity expiry=None, so his police_verification reminder (20 days) was never sent. 7 driver profiles were excluded. Changed the query to $elemMatch; Ravi now gets exactly one reminder and repeated run-check calls send no duplicates. Frontend (375x667): ERP More -> Staff performance leaderboard works; all 7 period chips load; owner/ops cards show metric values. Document expiry screen shows doc-type labels (Identity proof / Police verification / Driving licence) with paused status. Ravi home shows docs-warning-card (police verification 20 days). Onboarding has onb-expiry-identity/police_verification/address_proof inputs. Demo Driver 1 home shows 'Documents expired — jobs paused'; the online toggle is blocked with a toast; the renew button opens onboarding. Ops does not see Staff performance in More. No deprecated Expo packages found in the changed files.

critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent: query used 'documents.expiry': {'$nin':[None,'']}, which excludes profiles where ANY doc has no expiry. ID/police/address reminders and expired-doc pausing never ran for those drivers (Ravi included). Now uses {'documents': {'$elemMatch': {'expiry': {'$nin': [None, '']}}}}.

minor.issue: When a paused driver uploads a replacement identity/police doc (future expiry, still unverified), the old doc is replaced, so the row drops off the Document expiry list (days_left > 60). The driver stays paused (docs_expired) but the verification team loses sight of them. Doc rows always return renewal_uploaded=false. Keep showing paused drivers with 'replacement uploaded — open to verify'.

The support_tickets filter only uses updated_at >= since (no < until), so prev_month/quarter periods count tickets updated after the period end. Also runs one bookings.find_one per booking_assign audit row (N+1), which will be slow for period=all.
Un-verifying (verified=false) an identity/police doc does not re-add it to docs_expired or pause the driver; there is no audit detail on which doc_type was verified.

ui_bugs.issue: On a 375px screen the labels are cut off: 'TICKETS HA…', '1ST RESPO…', 'DOCS VERI…', 'REJECTED/…', 'AVG DISPAT…', 'QUOTES · F…'. Use shorter labels, 2 columns, or allow 2 lines.
